summary_1line: After King Dasharatha’s cremation, Bharata completes funeral rites, distributes charity, and mourns deeply with Shatrughna before sages urge them to continue the ceremonies.

image_candidates.scene_text: Bharata stands beside the cold funeral pyre, staring at the white ashes of his father’s bones before collapsing to the ground in grief.
Shatrughna falls senseless beside Bharata near the pyre while ministers and sages rush forward to lift the grieving princes.
Vasishtha raises the sorrowful Bharata and counsels him beside the riverbank where the final funeral rites are to continue.
